verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates AI coding agents and provides diff review, so surfacing license or public-code matching references for AI-generated code is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions code referencing, license detection, or public-code matching. The diff and review features (conductor-docs-21) are an adjacent capability and do not count.
